requirements.text: The product shall plot the data points in a scientifically correct manner.
The grid axis should be labelled correctly according to the input from the data file.
Data points should be coloured in accordance to the cluster number (contained in the data file)
The product should be able to handle up to 2000 data points.
A single click of the mouse over a data point should bring up the name of the data point.
A double-click of the mouse over the data point should cause the application to display all the data point's details.
The product should allow multiple points to clicked so that multiple names can be displayed.
The product should allow the grid to be oriented by the user.
Rotation, zoom and move functions should be employed.

The system shall implement strict input validation for all uploaded tab-delimited files to prevent injection attacks and ensure that users can only access data sets for which they have explicit authorization.
The application shall implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure that only authorized researchers can upload, view, or modify specific biological data sets.
The response to a change in the orientation (rotation, zoom, move) shall be rendered within 100ms of the user input.
The system shall validate the input data file format against the specified schema and provide a clear error message to the user if the file is malformed or contains invalid data types.
The application shall initialize and render 2000 data points within 30 seconds on the minimum specified hardware.
The application shall implement a timeout mechanism and provide a user-friendly notification if the connection to the server is lost or if the server fails to respond within 10 seconds.
The program shall start and render 2000 data points within 30 seconds on the specified minimum hardware.
The system shall support a minimum of 2000 data points while maintaining the defined interaction latency of 2 seconds.
